stops.name: Norwegische Gipfelmuseum
stops.detail: The Norwegian Summit Museum, located in Åndalsnes, shows the history of mountaineering in Norway.

stops.name: Kapelle
stops.detail: Directly at the train station, a small chapel was set up in an old Norwegian railway carriage.

stops.name: Trollstigen
stops.detail: Åndalsnes is also popular as a starting point for the trip over the Trollstigen, which winds up to the top of the pass over a length of 18 kilometers with a gradient of 12% in impressive serpentines, from where there is a wonderful view towards Åndalsnes.

stops.name: Stabkirche Rødven
stops.detail: The Rødven Stave Church with a nave and south portal from the 13th century is also located not far from the village.
